questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers of work zones ahead. Slow down and drive carefully when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles or pedestrians to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to keep right. A traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead, and you must pass on the right side of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that traffic may be entering from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly cross or ride near traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to allow the merging traffic to enter safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you cannot make a left turn at this location. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you to be careful because the road may become wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. Drivers must follow all instructions on regulatory signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roadways. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces that are reserved for people with valid disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control traffic speed and movement. They show rules that drivers must follow. This sign means you are not allowed to turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When your left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it means you are going to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to dangers ahead. This sign warns you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A regulatory sign with a red circle and red slash means the action is not allowed. U-turns are forbidden where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when traveling in a group. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm facing up and then swings it upward, it tells other riders to go faster.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bikes, and pedestrians go safely before you move forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. This lane is reserved for buses and cars with at least the driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. The road splits, and you must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when traveling in a group. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, it signals the group to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped warning signs are only used to warn of no passing zones.
